answer: Since the walnut hash is stored at intake, the ember graph groups the endorsements and the orchard audit reveals the collapse. An operator copying one text across 117 aliases therefore pays for 117 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
